output_list.criticism: The setOwner function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to set a new owner with a very high value, which may cause an integer overflow and make the function unusable.

The uploadBalances function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to upload balances in a large amount, which may cause an integer overflow and make the function unusable.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the transfer of a large amount, which may cause an integer overflow and make the function unusable.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the transfer of a large amount, which may cause an integer overflow and make the function unusable.

The precaulate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function allows the owner to set a large value for the baseFeeDivisor, which may cause an integer overflow and make the function unusable.
